correctness.rationale: Exact conditional expectations give E[D_n^2] recursion and a separate E[S_i D_i] identity; the gamma-product solution has strictly positive factors. The sign polynomial equals 8b^2p(p*-p), and monotonicity proves all four finite-time regimes. Uniform gamma ratios prove the precise critical-age exponent and coefficient and exact boundary decay. Independent finite-state rational propagation passed 470 checks; finite verification is not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison with the two directly relevant mixed-urn primary papers found color-proportion limits but no sampled-color sign diagram, all-lag formula, or critical cross-age law. A six-query published-finding corpus search found closer but nonimplicative urn findings on population imbalance and other statistics. General urn-autocovariance formulas could represent undiscovered implicit prior art; the risk is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: Two separately meaningful thresholds distinguish immediate versus eventual anti-persistence of observable successive sampled colors. The nontrivial fractional-power divergence of the reversal age and a faster decay exponent exactly at the second threshold are structural finite-to-asymptotic effects, rather than arbitrary parameter substitution.
